1474 edaphizo {ed-af-id'-zo}

源自 1475; 動詞

欽定本 - lay even with the ground 1; 1

1) 丟擲到地上
   1a) 指城市和建築物, 被拆毀移平  (#路19:44|)
record.edic_text:
1474 edaphizo {ed-af-id'-zo}

from 1475;; v

AV - lay even with the ground 1; 1

1) to throw to the ground
   1a) both of cities and buildings, to raze, level with the earth
   1b) metaph. of men
